verdict.rationale: The Google Authenticator GitHub project documents support for the HOTP (RFC 4226) counter-based algorithm alongside TOTP, so HOTP tokens are covered. Nothing in the pack shows support for the other non-standard token types the story names. Missing for 10: Steam Guard token support, custom TOTP periods, custom digit lengths, and hands-on or app-level corroboration of HOTP in the current mobile app.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths

citations.quote: These implementations support the HMAC-Based One-time Password (HOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 4226 and the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 6238.
